title: Quietly Sweet French Tomato Confit
description: A gentle, aerated French dish featuring sweet confit tomatoes and the nutty flavor of kinako, perfect for a quiet sick day at home, and friendly to sugar-free diets.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the chopped tomatoes with olive oil, garlic, thyme, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Transfer the tomato mixture to a baking dish and roast in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
While the tomatoes are roasting, prepare the kinako topping by mixing the kinako with a small amount of water to form a smooth paste.
After the tomatoes have roasted for 30 minutes, remove them from the oven and let them cool slightly.
Stir the kinako paste into the roasted tomatoes and continue to let them cool to room temperature.
Once the tomatoes have cooled, garnish with grated carrot and chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the Quietly Sweet French Tomato Confit at room temperature, enjoying the gentle flavors and textures.
Consider serving with a side of whole grain bread or over a bed of mixed greens for a more filling meal.
